details.flavorMarkdown: *A large black corvid with an iridescent throat, wedge-shaped tail and keen, curious eyes. It remembers faces and treats unattended food and interesting objects as opportunities.*

### Peck

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Bright objects disappear from an unattended camp.

**Purpose:** Find food and interesting things without being caught.

**Tactics and retreat:** Peck only when cornered; take to the air at the first opening.

**Counterplay and conversation:** A covered food bowl or a glittering trinket buys its attention.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** Calls; cannot report human speech verbatim

**Loot:** A nest may hold one small lost object.

**Summoning:** Animal 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/raven.md).

**Reference type:** physical

**Utility factor:** 1.1
